name: maestro
_note: Maestro (Evan Fung) is a UCI engine in C++ with a Stockfish NNUE embedded at build time via incbin (../bin/nn-eba324f53044.nnue relative to src/nnue.cpp). Perft is invoked via `go perft N`. The output is a divide listing (`Move: m Nodes: c`) followed by a tab-indented summary block — `Total Nodes:`, `Duration:`, `Performance:` lines. The perft routine in src/engine.cpp is single-threaded (just calls perftTest), so even though Threads is exposed (declared max 12), only single-no-cache is meaningful. End regex matches the Performance line so the runner reads through the whole summary.
